These are the final figures for the air pollution analysis

Setting up

Workspace:

```{r}
# Setting up the workspace 
if(Sys.getenv("RSTUDIO") == '1' & !knitr::is_html_output()) { # If using Rstudio and not rendering
  setwd(dirname(rstudioapi::getActiveDocumentContext()$path))
} else if(Sys.getenv("RSTUDIO") != '1'){ # If using Rscript
  initial.options <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = FALSE)
  file.arg.name <- "--file="
  script.name <- sub(file.arg.name, "", initial.options[grep(file.arg.name, initial.options)])
  script.basename <- dirname(script.name)
  setwd(file.path(getwd(), script.basename))
}
```

Building the cohort and cleaning the covariates

```{r}
# Decide cancer of interest:
# This analysis is focused on breast cancer 
select_cancer <- "breast_cancer"

# set if cancer is first ever any cancer (YES) - no previous cancers of any type (except NMSC)
# or first of its type (NO) -there may be previous diagnosis of other cancer (except NMSC)
first_ever <- "YES"

source("GS_analysis/Script/Cohort_Build.R")


# COHORT DEFINITION
# Menopausal Status
  # "post" - POSTMENOPAUSAL cohort
  # "pre" - PREMENOPAUSAL cohort
  # "all" - ENTIRE cohort
menopausal_status <- "all"

# EVENT DEFINITION
# ER status 
  # "positive" - positive er status BC coded as events only
  # "negative" - negative er status BC coded as events only
  # "all"- all BC coded as events
er_event <- "all"
# Menopausal Status
  # "post" - postmenopausal BC coded as events only
  # "pre" - premenopausal BC coded as events only
  # "all" - all BC coded as events
menopausal_event <- "all"

source("GS_analysis/Script/CleanCovariates_NAincluded.R")
source("GS_analysis/Script/CleanExposure.R")

complete_cohort <- complete_cohort %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(BMI)
  ) # Do not include those who have missing BMI
```

# Analysis set up

Time lag definitions

```{r}
complete_cohort <- complete_cohort %>%
  mutate(
    meno_age_est = as.numeric(meno_age_est)
  )

complete_cohort_2lag <- complete_cohort %>%
  mutate(
    age_start365 = age_start365 + 730
  ) %>%
  filter(
    c_age365 > age_start365
  )

complete_cohort_5lag <- complete_cohort %>%
  mutate(
    age_start365 = age_start365 + 1825
  ) %>%
  filter(
    c_age365 > age_start365
  )

```

```{r}
source("GS_analysis/Script/TimeSplit_Menopause_2lag.R")
source("GS_analysis/Script/TimeSplit_Menopause_5lag.R")
source("GS_analysis/Script/TimeSplit_Menopause.R")
```

# Table 1: Data Description

```{r}

nolag <- covariate(complete_cohort, bc_nolag)
twolag <- covariate(complete_cohort, bc_2lag)
fivelag <- covariate(complete_cohort, bc_5lag)

outcome <- bind_rows(nolag, twolag, fivelag) %>%
  mutate(
    Cases = case_when(
      Subcategories == 0 ~ 0, 
      TRUE ~ Cases
    ),
    `Rate per 1,000` = case_when(
      Subcategories == 0 ~ 0, 
      TRUE ~ `Rate per 1,000`
    ), 
    Subcategories = case_when(
      Subcategories == 1 ~ "Case", 
      Subcategories == 0 ~ "Not Case", 
      TRUE ~ "ERROR"
    )
  )

age <- covariate(complete_cohort, AgeEntry_cat)
yearofentry <- covariate(complete_cohort, matchyear_cat)

carstairs <- covariate(complete_cohort, Carstairs_cat)
bmi <- covariate(complete_cohort, BMI_cat)
smoking <- covariate(complete_cohort, Smoking_cat)
alcohol <- covariate(complete_cohort, Alcohol_cat)
education <- covariate(complete_cohort, Educ_cat)

parity <- covariate(complete_cohort, Parity_cat)
agefirstbirth <- covariate(complete_cohort, Birth1_age_cat)
HRT <- covariate(complete_cohort, HRT_cat)
meno <- covariate(cohort_mensplit, Menopause_cat)

table1 <- bind_rows(outcome, age, yearofentry, carstairs, bmi, smoking, alcohol, education, parity, agefirstbirth, HRT, meno)

table1_tbl <- table1 %>%
    group_by(covariate) %>%
    gt(rowname_col = NULL) %>%
    # Center everything
    cols_align(
      align = "center",
      columns = everything()
    ) %>%
    # Bold the column headers
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
      locations = cells_column_labels()
    ) %>%
    # Style the group headers (time_lag)
    tab_style(
      style = list(
        cell_text(weight = "bold"),
        cell_fill(color = "lightgray"),
        cell_borders(sides = "top"),
        cell_borders(sides = "bottom")
      ),
      locations = cells_row_groups(groups = everything())
    ) %>%
    # Add title
    tab_header(
      title = "Table 1: Data Description")
    

table1_tbl

```

# Table 2: Bias Assessment

## Proportional Hazards

This is for no time lag and point exposures

```{r}
source("GS_analysis/Script/ProportionalHazards.R")

ph_summary_clean

```

## ANOVA with exposure

ANova test with confounders and exposure

p-value \< 0.05 = air pollution exposure differs across at least on level of the categorical variable

eta squared = effect size, proportion of exposure explained by the categorical variable

pvalue will almost always be significant because large sample size, should focus on eta squared

```{r}
source("GS_analysis/Script/CounfounderStrength.R")

all_anova
```

## E-values

E - values

```{r}
source("GS_analysis/Script/BiasAssessment.R")

all_evalues
```

# Supplementary Figure 1 : Sensitivity Full Cohort


```{r}
#| label: Supp Fig 1
#| fig-align: center
#| fig-width: 20
#| fig-height: 5
#| warning: false
#| echo: false
point_nolag_plot <- full_cohort_plot(all_results, lag_value = "nolag", exp_def = "point", plot_title = "Point Exposure")

average_2lag_plot <- full_cohort_plot(all_results, lag_value = "2lag", exp_def = "average", plot_title = "2 year time lag")

average_5lag_plot <- full_cohort_plot(all_results, lag_value = "5lag", exp_def = "average", plot_title = "5 year time lag")

point_nolag_plot + average_2lag_plot +average_5lag_plot + plot_annotation(
  title = "Sensitivity Analysis: Full Cohort", 
  theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 28))
)
```


# Supplementary Figure 2 : Sensitivity Menopausal

```{r}
#| label: Supp Fig 2
#| fig-align: center
#| fig-width: 20
#| fig-height: 20
#| warning: false
#| echo: false
#| 
point_menopause_plot <- subanalysis_plot(
                            all_menopause,
                            type = "Menopausal Status",
                            lag_choice = "no years",
                            exp_choice = "point")

lag2_menopause_plot <- subanalysis_plot(
                            all_menopause,
                            type = "Menopausal Status",
                            lag_choice = "2 years",
                            exp_choice = "average")


lag5_menopause_plot <- subanalysis_plot(
                            all_menopause,
                            type = "Menopausal Status",
                            lag_choice = "5 years",
                            exp_choice = "average")



point_row <- wrap_elements(
  (point_menopause_plot) +
    plot_layout(ncol = 1) +
    plot_annotation(title = "Point Exposure", theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 25)))
)

lag2_row <- wrap_elements(
  (lag2_menopause_plot) +
    plot_layout(ncol = 1) +
    plot_annotation(title = "2-year lag", theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 25)))
)

lag5_row <- wrap_elements(
  (lag5_menopause_plot) +
    plot_layout(ncol = 1) +
    plot_annotation(title = "5-year lag", theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 25)))
)

(point_row / lag2_row / lag5_row) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Sensitivity Analysis: By Menopausal Status",
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 28))
  )
```
